title: Castlevania: Aria of Sorrow
subtitle: A future eclipse contains an old castle
summary: Castlevania: Aria of Sorrow is Konami's third Game Boy Advance adventure in the series, following Soma Cruz into Dracula's castle during a solar eclipse in 2035. body: Castlevania: Aria of Sorrow is Konami's third Game Boy Advance adventure in the series, following Soma Cruz into Dracula's castle during a solar eclipse in 2035. The unfamiliar protagonist gains the ability to absorb powers from defeated creatures, making the inhabitants part of his developing repertoire. Weapons, experience and an interconnected map retain the exploratory foundation of the handheld games. Its future setting gives the old castle another mystery, while Soma's changing abilities provide a practical reason to pay attention to the enemies encountered along the route through its rooms.

The Tactical Soul system allows Soma to acquire abilities associated with defeated monsters. Different souls provide attacks, support effects or movement options, turning the growing collection into a set of choices about how to approach the next situation. A creature can therefore be valuable for more than the experience awarded when it is defeated. The possibility of obtaining its power changes the relationship between combat and exploration: an encounter may supply a new way to fight, or the means of reaching a place that the current equipment cannot yet make accessible.

Movement abilities gradually connect areas that initially appear separate, encouraging the player to remember blocked passages and return with another option available. Equipment and soul combinations give those return visits a different practical context as Soma develops. The castle remains a continuous place to investigate rather than a series of independent stages. Aria of Sorrow brings its collection system into that familiar structure, making progress feel like the gradual alignment of two discoveries: understanding where a route leads and finding the particular capability that finally allows the protagonist to follow it.
